title: System administration
subtitle: Manage the members, shopping categories and shortcuts of your family space.

export.buttonTitle: Export all the family's data as JSON
export.title: Data backup and export
export.subtitle: Export all your family's data (users with passwords, shopping list, ordered categories, tasks, absences, guests, shortcuts and events) as JSON for backup or import.

members.title: Member management
members.subtitle: View, edit or remove the members of your family.
members.clickToEdit: Click to edit this member's details
members.pendingBadgeTitle: Invitation sent, waiting for the user to activate it
members.empty: No members found in this family.

restricted.text: {label} Only a user with the {role} role can change these settings.
restricted.label: Restricted access:

mcp.title: MCP connector (Claude)
mcp.subtitle: Generate a private URL to manage this family's events, presence, guests, shopping, tasks and meals directly from Claude, without a password. This URL gives full access to the family's data: only share it with people you trust and revoke it if it may have leaked.
mcp.copyNow: Copy this URL now: it will never be shown in full again.
mcp.active: Connector active · ends with {token} · created on {created} · last used: {lastUsed}
mcp.none: No active MCP connector for this family.

mealie.title: Mealie recipe server
mealie.subtitle: Connect your Mealie instance to search for a recipe when adding a meal: the dish, the recipe link and its ingredients are then filled in. The API token is created in Mealie, under {path}. It is stored encrypted and never sent to members' browsers.
mealie.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token

categories.title: Shopping categories
categories.subtitle: Customise the shopping aisles and reorder them with drag and drop. The number sets the order in which they appear in the shopping list.
categories.empty: No categories set up. Click “+ New category” to add one.
categories.tip: Tip: grab a category by its ⠿ handle and drag it up or down to change its display order immediately.
categories.name: Category name
categories.deleteConfirm: Do you really want to delete the category {name}?
categories.itemsKept: Existing shopping items will be kept.

iconHelp: Pick one below or type an emoji:

shortcuts.title: Web & app shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Set up quick links (e.g. school portal, Drive, home automation…) shown in the navigation bar of every family member.
shortcuts.empty: No shortcuts set up. Click “+ New shortcut” to add a direct link to a website or app for your family.
shortcuts.name: Shortcut title
shortcuts.namePlaceholder: e.g. School portal, Synology, Google Drive…

addMember.title: Invite a member to the family
addMember.existing: Existing account found ({name}). An invitation will be sent to link your family to their account.
addMember.newAccount: New account: an invitation with a secure activation link will let them create their password.
addMember.detailedLater: The detailed setting (by day and by meal) will be available once the invitation is accepted.

editMember.title: Edit member: {name}
editMember.resendTitle: Send an email with a new activation link valid for 2 hours
